scenes.world: A dim feasting hall at night lit by braziers and torches, smoke, firelight on jeering faces, quick hard cuts.

captain.asks: Shot against reverse between jeering youth and the bald beggar in firelight, fast and hard.
diagnosis: The reverse side works: bald head and lined eyes hold firelit continuity.
The mockers have no face; Melantho is Penelope reused and the young man is a mouth.
The flying stool is an office chair and a dustbin: the climax is refused.

prologue: The disguised king stays in his own hall among the suitors. They treat him as entertainment, and he quietly measures each of them.
